name: Arnold's Gymnastics Academy Summer Camp
description_short: A summer day camp at a gymnastics gym in Mansfield, MA, with half-day (ages 3+) and full-day (ages 4+) options. Each day includes an obstacle course, gymnastics and ninja instruction, snack, crafts and games, and the afternoon is mostly athletic instruction.

warnings: The page shows a season that is already over. No year is given, but the dates match 2026 (July 13, 2026 is a Monday and the page footer says © 2026), so these dates are from summer 2026. 2027 dates have not been posted.
The dates conflict: the header says 'JULY 13- AUGUST 27', but Week 7 is listed as 'August 24 - August 28'. Weeks 1–6 run Monday to Thursday.

The page doesn't say if $215 (half day) and $395 (full day) are weekly rates or totals for all 7 weeks. They look like weekly rates, but this isn't confirmed, so I left price_per_week and the weekly session prices blank.
Move Up Skills Clinics are 1-hour Wednesday classes taught by team coaches for gymnasts working toward the next level, not general camp. Blue/Purple runs 3–4pm and Red/Yellow runs 4–5pm.
February and April vacation camps are listed with dates 'TBD' ($55 half day / $105 full day per day), so I didn't record them as sessions.
